analysis.investment_thesis: Anupam Rasayan earns an ROE of just 3.32% on a massively expanded capital base, has delivered declining revenue and profits for two consecutive years, and trades at a P/E of 85x — this is the very definition of overpaying for underperformance.
key_strengths: Promoter holding at 59.07% is above my threshold — skin in the game is present
Long-term revenue CAGR of 19.2% from FY19–FY25 shows the business had a good growth phase in its history
Operating margins at 18.15% are decent and stable for specialty chemicals
key_risks: ROE of 3.32% is catastrophically low — the company earns less than a fixed deposit on equity deployed, destroying shareholder value
Free cash flow has been negative in 4 of 5 years (FY25 FCF: -440 Cr) despite massive capex — returns on capital invested are not materialising
Revenue and profits are declining: revenue fell from INR 1,602 Cr (FY23) to INR 1,437 Cr (FY25); net profit from INR 217 Cr to INR 160 Cr
red_flags: P/E of 85x on a business with ROE of 3.32% and declining profits is indefensible from a value perspective — the market is pricing in a turnaround that may never come
Debt has tripled from INR 423 Cr (FY21) to INR 1,223 Cr (FY25) while profits are falling — leverage is rising as returns deteriorate
Finance costs grew from INR 24 Cr (FY19) to INR 112 Cr (FY25), consuming an ever-larger share of operating profits
analysis.detailed_analysis:
Anupam Rasayan invested heavily in capacity expansion — CWIP peaked at INR 609 Cr in FY24 — yet the returns are nowhere to be found. An ROE of 3.32% with a ROCE of 7.33% means the company earns far less than its cost of capital. When a business earns less than its cost of capital, growth actually destroys value, and this company has been growing its asset base aggressively.

The combination of declining revenue (INR 1,602 Cr → INR 1,437 Cr), rising interest costs (INR 63 Cr → INR 112 Cr), chronically negative free cash flow, and a P/E of 85x is one of the clearest avoids I have seen in this batch. There is no margin of safety — only hope priced in at a premium. I have never built wealth by paying 85x earnings for deteriorating businesses, and I do not intend to start now.
